candidate_policy: Reorder the same natural baseline Top10 SHA-distinct designs only if ALL ten have cached features; otherwise preserve full baseline ranking. No GT insertion or partial-set deletion.

features.S: visibility-weighted ColNomic MaxSim times overlap mass

selection: All 173 original validation queries: package macro Top1, then package macro MRR, then smaller beta, then M/S/L order. Historical exploratory evaluation.
controls: Query/reference roll controls use the SAME beta selected for S; also evaluate previously fixed S beta0.2. No historical learned head.
score: zscore(current scores within identical Top10) + beta*zscore(RoMa feature within those Top10)
limits: No dense warp/correspondence coordinates are stored.
Top128 cache is generated by original image retrieval, not current repaired retrieval.
Visibility maps cover full photographs and may align other objects; they are not human subject masks.
Unavailable pairs remain missing, never zero or negative evidence.
